simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָקֶה (H3348) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: יָקֶה (Yâqeh) means Jakeh , a symbolical name (for Solomon) First listed occurrence: Prov 30 1.

definitions.full: H3348. Yaqeh יָקֶה proper name, masculine father of Agur , הַמַּשָּׂא בִּןיָֿקֶה אָגוּר Prov 30:1 (read probably הַמַּשָּׂאִי or ׃מִמַּשָּׂא : see Be-Now xvi f f. )
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to obey; obedient;
